neighbours.label: the word that sets up a causal explanation (explain, account for, the reason, as contributing), just before the cause is named
fire: Rising rents may partly explain why so many young people are leaving the city.
Diet alone is not enough to account for the change in the birds' behaviour.
Is cheap fuel the reason why traffic has grown so fast?
Doctors cited poor sleep as a likely contributor to the rise in accidents.
The drought helps explain the sharp fall in wheat prices this year.
Investigators named worn brakes as the cause of the crash.
Low pay is often given as the main reason nurses quit the profession.
A faulty sensor could account for the strange readings overnight.
quiet: Rising rents may partly change how many young people live in the city.
Diet alone is not enough to change the birds' behaviour.
Is cheap fuel available at every station along the road?
Doctors described poor sleep at length in the report on accidents.
The drought came before the sharp fall in wheat prices this year.
Investigators examined the worn brakes after the crash.
Low pay is often discussed when nurses meet with the union.
A faulty sensor was replaced after the strange readings overnight.
